_purpose: Frozen per-bundle ceilings on OPEN `major` (REQUIRED) findings — ADR-012 D9. A RATCHET: may only shrink, in the commit that shrinks the population.
_why_not_python: A 15-code dict literal in a check module trips `bundle_registry_consistency` Leg C — a hand-maintained roster parallel to `scripts/bundle_registry.py`, which is a known-bad pattern here. The per-file allowlist would blind the gate to the whole module, so the ceilings live in data instead. A bundle ABSENT from this file reads 0, which is the strictest possible default: a newly-registered bundle starts clean and any open major fails it.
